briefdescription.para: Determine the hyperboloid parameters, including 1) the rotation angle m_angRot from the Local frame to the Local Normal frame using the right-hand rule and 2) the center coordinates m_xcLocNorm and m_zcLocNorm in the Local Normal frame.

detaileddescription.para:
The Local frame is defined as follows:
Tangential direction is X
Sagittal direction is Y
Normal direction is Z
The rotation angle depends on the relationship between p and q, and the sign of m_vCenTang.z:

listitem.para:
If p > q:
If m_vCenTang.z < 0: angRot = -acuteAngRot
If m_vCenTang.z > 0: angRot = -(π - acuteAngRot)

If p < q:
If m_vCenTang.z < 0: angRot = acuteAngRot
If m_vCenTang.z > 0: angRot = π - acuteAngRot

parameterdescription.para: Input point of the ray in the Local frame.

simplesect.para: True if the intersection is found, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Validate the intersection point (xi, yi, zi) with the hyperboloid surface.

parameterdescription.para: The input point of the ray in the Local frame.
The input direction vector of the ray in the Local frame (should be normalized).
The parameter t for the ray equation.

simplesect.para: True if the point (xi, yi, zi) is on the hyperboloid surface, false otherwise.
The function checks if the point (xi, yi, zi) lies within the hyperboloid limits and if the height calculated from the hyperboloid equation matches the input z-coordinate.
The function assumes that the hyperboloid is centered at the origin in the Local Normal frame and that the hyperboloid is described by the equation x^2/a^2 - y^2/b^2 - z^2/c^2 = 1.
